description: Retrieval eval set. Each item is a question plus `expect_any`: substrings, at least one of which SHOULD appear in the `source` metadata of a retrieved chunk (drives hit@k, MRR, precision@k). Optionally add `expect_all`: substrings that must ALL be retrieved for the question to be fully answered — this drives recall. Matching is case-insensitive substring against the source filename. NOTE on this KB: 'Become a Product Manager - Review sheets, activities, & resources.pdf' is a full-course lecture-summary compilation that substantively covers almost every topic, so it is a legitimate source for most questions and tends to dominate retrieval. It's listed as an acceptable source below; the dedicated CHEAT SHEET files are listed too so the metrics stay sensitive to whether focused sources surface. Edit freely as the knowledge base grows.
